title: Fixed Raised Lattice and Drum Portcullis
description: One newly authored complete static portcullis gateway appearance in a fixed raised pose. Two deep grounded stone-look piers contain real inward-open guide channels. One continuous thick orthogonal timber lattice has genuine through cells and spans the guides above a clear lower opening. A full transverse upper axle and two flanged winding drums carry continuous gate-to-drum-to-rear-weight rope paths; broad separate hanging weights and an end crank complete the visible fixed assembly. The overhead rear crosshead leaves the upper winding assembly exposed. This is not an old solid sluice with holes painted on, a sideways scissor lattice gate, or a raised drawbridge deck resized. All whole geometry is newly authored; no old model imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metre Z-up, whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin, one isolated prop and zero scenes. Static fictional architecture only: no lifting, movement clearances, gearing, brakes, security, defense, egress, load balance, building suitability, construction or safety verification. No water, people, weapon, animation or interactive mechanism.
